title: Run a shared step
summary: Express.js: Run a shared step. Change the school name.
introduction: Middleware runs before a later handler when it calls next. GET / shows the value this middleware placed in res.locals.
learningObjectives: Run a shared step with Express.js

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Run a shared step

blocks.text: The shared middleware sets school on this response and calls next. The handler reads that value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Middleware must send a response or call next; otherwise the request waits.
